pages.text: Columns of pylons hold a $(l:energy_storage/resonance_core)Resonance Core$(/l)'s crystal steady with their beams, and they are the $(l)only way power goes in and out$() of the core.$(br)$(li)$(l)1$(): 1, 2, 3-8, 16,000 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)2$(): 2, 3, 4-10, 128,000 FE/t

Stack $(item)Stabilizer Pylon$()s into $(l)columns$(): the bottom block gets a footing, the top one the glowing $(l)emitter ring$(). The beam leaves through a pulsing lens on the side of the ring that faces the crystal, at the crystal's height.
pages.title: Building the columns

pages.text: $(li)Put the columns on the $(l)same level$() as the pedestal, $(l)in line with it$() on its sides (north, south, east, west), one column per side.$(br)$(li)Each tier needs $(l)as many columns as its number$(), each $(l)one block taller$() than the tier and within the distance in the table, counted from the pedestal.
$(li)Nothing may stand between a column and the crystal at the crystal's height.

With enough columns the core is $(l)Online$(): the crystal spins and shines white and its heart grows as it fills up. With too few it is $(l)Unstable$(): the crystal slows down and flickers violet and $(l)nothing goes in or out$(). What it already stores is kept.

The pylons are the core's $(l)only way in and out$(): connect cables to $(l)any block$() of a linked column; an Energy Conduit plugs into a socket that appears on the pylon's side. Each column takes and gives up to the amount in the table.
pages.title: Power in and out

pages.text: $(li)Cables and generators fill the core through any linked pylon, CyberFarm's or any other mod's.

$(li)The core never pushes power out by itself. To draw from it, $(l)right-click the arm$() of the $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l) that touches a pylon, so the cable $(l)pulls$() (see $(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)); other mods' cables that pull work too.
